verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) and a markdown docs index at /docs.md. Individual doc pages are also served as .md files. On top of that, Bento ships agent-oriented material: ready-made agent prompts and Bento Skills, which tells an agent when to use MCP, the CLI, an SDK, or n8n, with safety guidance. missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually consuming these docs successfully, and evidence of how complete llms.txt is (the excerpts shown read partly as marketing feature lists).
